subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata attempt-result contract and retry classified empty server_error turns before failover once proof and conflicts are resolved?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the change crosses harness compatibility, session-state, provider-routing, and message-delivery semantics that automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after proof and conflict refresh
options.body: Require a rebase/merge-conflict fix and redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then land this current-attempt metadata contract if the proof holds.

options.title: Use a sibling candidate as canonical
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer the still-open https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 shape or another canonical branch for the same linked issue.

options.title: Reject the new result field
options.body: Ask for a different internal current-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want to extend the attempt-result contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and conflict refresh
recommendation.body: Require a rebase/merge-conflict fix and redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then land this current-attempt metadata contract if the proof holds.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and authored adjacent retry-safety changes in the same agent runner surfaces and is the strongest history-backed owner for the contract decision.
